name: Variety Show
description: We're gearing up for our upcoming Variety Show and need parent volunteers to help make it a success! Volunteer opportunities include Stage Hands - to assist performers and Concession Organizer - to coordinate snacks and sales. We are also looking for a volunteer who can provide a digital keyboard for the event. To apply, you can share your talent - sing, rap, dance, lip sync, magic, musical instrument, cheer performance, skit, monologue, jump rope, yo yo, puppet show, comedy routine, impressions, mime, martial arts demo, poetry, baton twirling.

description: Show this flyer for dine-in and take-out and enter code MAR580 for online orders, and 20% will go to the PTA!

name: Pioneer Crab Feed
description: Come hungry (and thirsty!) to the Pioneer High School Athletics 2026 Crab Feed. It's an all-you-can-eat + all-you-can-drink night that keeps the fun (and the cracking!) going.

name: Multicultural Fair
description: This year's Multicultural Fair will take place. A beloved tradition at this school, we once again invite you to share your culture with us, whether it's helping with your country's booth (or starting one if it isn't represented yet!), fashion show, or with a group cultural performance.

name: PTA Board Positions
description: We are looking for members of our Los Alamitos community to join our PTA Executive Board for 2026-27 school year! More details about specific positions will be shared soon, but if you're interested in getting involved, please email us or connect with any of our current board members.

name: Reading Lab Volunteers Needed
description: The Reading Lab is a tutoring program for students who would benefit from extra help with fundamental reading skills. We are looking for volunteers who can come in once per week (Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday) during the school year. Training for new tutors is provided!!

name: Castillero PTA Board
description: Castillero PTA is looking for incoming 6th grade parents to serve on the board. Castillero PTA funds and/ or runs events and programs like school dances, carnival, spirit wear, teacher and staff appreciation, and teacher grants.
